End-to-End Machine Learning Services

From the first strategy conversation to post-deployment monitoring, our machine learning development services cover every stage of your ML journey — delivered by practitioners who've done it before, across industries that matter to you.
ML Strategy & Consulting

Even before we write any code, our team assesses your data landscape and maps your business goals to machine learning use cases to create a priority roadmap with well-defined return on investment targets. Our machine learning consulting services empower your organisation to make informed decisions.
Data Engineering & Preparation

Bad data is the most common problem in ML projects. We develop robust data pipelines, prepare your data sets, engineer features, and ensure that you have production-grade training data right out of the gate.
Custom ML Model Development

The models we create will be specific to your domain, whether you need to fine-tune an existing LLM on your data or need us to train predictive models for you using traditional ML techniques or even deep learning.
Azure ML Solution Development

By utilising Azure Machine Learning Studio, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure Databricks, we build ML-enabled applications including recommendation systems, demand prediction models, document intelligence solutions, and anomaly detection systems.
MLOps & Workflow Integration

Deployment of the model is just the start. We build MLOps workflows for your models to be versioned, monitored, retrained, and optimised constantly, to keep your ML systems accurate while your data and your company changes.
Support, Monitoring & Maintenance

It is not just about delivering a model and leaving. We make sure to perform continuous monitoring and maintenance of the system performance to ensure high levels of accuracy under all operating conditions.
ML Expertise Across the Full Landscape
Our team brings genuine hands-on expertise across the full machine learning landscape — from classical algorithms to cutting-edge deep learning and AutoML automation.
Deep Learning & Neural Networks CNNs, RNNs, Transformers – we develop neural network models that can work with images, natural language processing, time series, and beyond.
Natural Language Processing Sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, document classification, and training LLMs for specific language applications.
Predictive Analytics Demand forecasting, churn prediction, credit scoring, and risk modelling with interpretable, production-ready models.

Recommendation Systems Collaborative filtering, content-based, and hybrid methods that create value by driving user engagement and sales uplift.

Reinforcement Learning Agents that use reinforcement learning to make decisions about dynamic pricing, resource allocation, and supply chains.
AutoML & Model Automation Azure Automated ML and MLflow-powered pipelines that reduce time-to-deployment and lower the barrier to experimentation.

How We Build Machine Learning Solutions
A disciplined process is what separates ML projects that deliver ongoing value. Here's how we work.

Strategy & Roadmap We co-create a prioritised ML strategy with clear use cases, success metrics, cost estimates, and a phased rollout plan.
Data Engineering The data pipeline, data quality checks, and feature stores required for accurate learning are all built by us.
Model Development Our data scientists design, train, and rigorously evaluate models — iterating until performance meets your real-world requirements.
Integration & Deployment We deploy your ML solution into your existing workflows on Azure — with APIs, dashboards, or embedded application logic, as needed.
Monitor & Optimise We track model drift, retrain on new data, and optimise continuously so performance improves rather than decays over time.

FAQ

faqs.q: What does a machine learning development company do?
a: A machine learning development company, like Q2M Solutions, receives the problem statement and data from the client and creates intelligent solutions that leverage knowledge gained through the analysis of patterns in data to make decisions, predictions, or automate certain processes. The entire process – strategy, data preprocessing, modelling, implementation, and optimisation – falls under this umbrella term.

faqs.q: Do we need a huge dataset to begin?
a: No. It very much depends on the application, and the amount of data is not always necessary to have in order to create something useful. Sometimes small but good-quality datasets and transfer learning could do wonders. The assessment phase was specially created to provide you with an honest picture of your data maturity.

faqs.q: How is ML consulting different from ML development?
a: Consulting services are all about strategy, road mapping, architectural advice, and guidance – perfect for you if you have an internal team and require expertise from someone else. Our development services will mean that our team will be working to build, train, and deploy the model and solutions for you.

faqs.q: Which industries do you have the most ML experience with?
a: Our team has lots of experience with finance, health care, manufacturing, and retail industries – these are areas where predictive modelling and anomaly detection really make a difference. Having said that, our methodology and technical stack translate well across most data-generating industries.

faqs.q: What is the usual timeline for an ML project?
a: The time frame depends on the complexity and volume of the project. We work hand-in-hand with you to set milestones and give estimates of the time frame during the first consultations.

faqs.q: How do you keep ML models relevant as data changes?
a: Models are frequently trained and fine-tuned according to changing data and industry trends. Constant monitoring allows us to spot drift, and there is always a strong feedback loop with the client in place to make sure models stay relevant.

faqs.q: Do you offer any support or maintenance?
a: Yes, at Q2M Solutions we provide support and maintenance services for all machine learning solutions that we build. The service includes constant monitoring and tuning of the models and solutions to make sure they operate well. We fix potential issues and modify the solutions to adjust to new data trends and changing business needs.
